# A solution fault found deep inside the generated compiler comes
# back as a positioned diagnostic: exit 1, file:line:col on stderr,
# nothing on stdout. The unknown-element fault only exists once the
# catalogue is live, so this one case proves the whole
# generate-compile-run relay; the diagnostic wording matrix itself
# stays with solution's own tables, not here.
[short] skip 'drives the go toolchain'

exec go mod edit -replace=github.com/modern-engineering/prototype=$SDLREPO
cp $SDLREPO/go.sum go.sum
status 1 sdl build
stderr 'sol\.sdl:5:8: unknown element Gone'
! stdout .

-- go.mod --
module example.test/sol

go 1.25.0

require github.com/modern-engineering/prototype v0.0.0
-- sol.sdl --
solution broken

import ff "github.com/modern-engineering/prototype/examples/ff"

deploy ff.Gone as G
